prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. High quality original Yautja 2D fighting-stage opaque depth plate, 'Porte de l’Audience'. Not a canonical named place. Reference1 informs heavy layered rock shelter and practical curved alien alloy only, do not reproduce its exact building or any text. Landscape1536x1024 or wider. Level side-stage camera looking at far architecture, no Dutch angle. There must be NO nearby combat platform, foreground floor, foot-contact line or foreground framing pillars. Bottom quarter continues into distant cliff/machinery shadow; the fight platform is a separate asset placed later.
Scene: a controlled entrance to a hunting-clan meeting lodge built horizontally into a broad arid escarpment. Main distant entrance is a broad low-segmented dark-bronze mechanical airlock, under a massive overlapping stone slab canopy, set back across a narrow canyon. Four curved rib supports and thick practical conduit bundles frame the airlock, warm amber status slots in the doorjambs, subtle alien incised abstract geometry, no recognizable language. The architecture is squat, massive and technologically sophisticated, resembling alien hunting-clan spacecraft material integrated with rock. Far off to left, staggered small shelter canopies follow the slope. Afternoon ivory desert light, restrained aged bronze, slate-grey basalt, warm reflected dust. Keep middle lower center calm; no characters or silhouettes and no spacecraft.
Distinctiveness: a practical horizontal entrance mechanism and layered geological shelter, not a high shrine, castle, monument or mask-shaped gate. No giant faces, Predator helmet effigies, statues, crowns, gods, medieval stairs, banners, flags, torches, braziers, gothic arches, sci-fi portal rings, floating structures, text, labels or UI. Rich realistic handpainted materials, controlled contrast for later fighter readability. No floor painted near viewer.
